title: Objective-Conditioned Active Preference Learning for Multi-Objective Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.05506v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with several objectives, such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty, typically relies on preference judgment for each objective, growing the annotation cost linearly with the number of objectives. Active preference learning can reduce this cost by selecting the comparisons whose labels are expected to change the policy most. Existing remedies either lack an objective-aware query selection mechanism for the multi-objective setting or regard conflicting preferences as harmful, therefore excluding them from the training data. We introduce OGC-DPO (Objective-conditioned Gradient Coverage DPO), an active learning framework that treats each (response pair, objective) combination as a separate query and measures its informativeness through the policy's own implicit gradient, without relying on an external reward model. OGC-DPO then selects the queries that most expand each objective's gradient coverag

translated_title: 面向多目标对齐的目标条件化主动偏好学习
translated_abstract: 将大型语言模型（LLM）与多个目标（如有用性、无害性和诚实性）进行对齐，通常需要对每个目标分别进行偏好判断，使标注成本随目标数量线性增长。主动偏好学习可以通过选择那些标签预期对策略改变最大的比较来降低这一成本。现有的方法要么缺乏面向多目标设置的目标感知查询选择机制，要么将相互冲突的偏好视为有害信息并将其排除在训练数据之外。我们提出了 OGC-DPO（目标条件化梯度覆盖 DPO），这是一个主动学习框架，它将每个（回复对，目标）组合视为一个独立的查询，并通过策略自身的隐式梯度来衡量其信息量，而无需依赖外部奖励模型。OGC-DPO 随后选择最能扩展每个目标梯度覆盖范围的查询。
tldr: 提出 OGC-DPO 主动学习框架，将（回复对，目标）组合视为独立查询并利用策略自身隐式梯度衡量信息量，主动选择最能扩展各目标梯度覆盖范围的比较样本，从而在无需外部奖励模型的情况下降低多目标对齐的标注成本。
en_tdlr: OGC-DPO treats each (response pair, objective) combination as a separate query and uses the policy's own implicit gradient to select comparisons that maximally expand each objective's gradient coverage, reducing annotation cost for multi-objective alignment without relying on an external reward model.
